description.html: With a volume of ~24 liters and dimensions of 40x20x30 cm, this terrarium includes a handmade 3D background. The background imitates natural relief, such as rock or bark, and adds depth to the space so animals can climb, hide and feel more secure.

With a floor area of 40x20 cm, this terrarium allows natural movement for ground-dwelling species and proper temperature zoning: a warm spot under the spot lamp and a cooler area on the opposite side. Mesh ventilation openings provide the airflow animals need to stay healthy and prevent condensation.

You can order this model with a custom film and background. If you need different dimensions or extra equipment (LED lighting, a thermostat, a lock), we build to your specification. Delivery to your address anywhere in Serbia.
